packageRules.description: Self-hosting is pinned to SDK 10.0.400 (SH-01 profile); do not bump it
Unity UPM packages come from packages.unity.com, not npmjs (avoids false MAL-2022-2066 match on the npm name-squat)
Source generator must stay on Roslyn 4.x so it loads on .NET 10 SDK / Unity compilers (CS8032)
